Item.Description: A transparency slide showing a detail of the right side saddle of a carousel pig. The pig is very well worn. The saddle is barely visible at the top of the image, being colored brown. Most of the image shows the saddle blanket, which is green with a yellow design on it. Part of the saddle blanket is black, having the paint removed. The skin of the pig ranges from a light to a dark brown, with the darkest parts being next to the saddle blanket and the tack. The tack is colored a light red. The slide reads “PULLEN PARK CAROUSEL PULLEN PARK 16B RIGHT DETAIL” at the top and “Pig RALEIGH NC WAKE CO 6/79 RR RALEIGH FINE ARTS SOCIETY” at the bottom.

Title: Pullen Park Carousel - PPC2019.001.534
